interpretation: Each strong-case criterion requires at least one matched complete frame, not recovery of every injected frame. Every missed strong frame in the new trial has a truth-near proposal selected but rejected while busy.
All new-trial strong FPGA positives agree with independently acquired and individually scored host frame supports. Host supports can overlap across basins/windows and are not independent trials.

New-trial short32 positives at 5 MS/s (one) and 60 MS/s (three) have no matching host positive. At 60 MS/s the host instead reports an unrelated in-band engineering-positive support; its evidence is retained. Neither detector is assigned calibrated RF-truth labels.
Weak and short signals remain limits. The new trial finds one weak frame at 2.5 MS/s and none at other rates; no 8-symbol burst is detected. Rolled code remains a shifted positive ambiguity.
All supported exported IQ and completed native fixed-point statistics pass exact replay comparison. Simulated pacing is not actual ADC, IIO, DMA or transport qualification.
The hardware ABI cannot prove the offline terminal-state exception; pending scorer observations remain conservatively rejected by host event attestation.
No gate or selector tuning was performed on the new trial outcomes.
